title: Beep Bop
style: Electro-pop with playful four-on-the-floor pulse, rubbery synth bass, clipped drum machine hits, and a bouncy verse-to-chorus lift; verses stay minimal with tongue-in-cheek vocal phrasing, pre-chorus opens with rising filtered synths and handclaps, chorus snaps into stacked doubles and gang shouts on the hook. Use little glitch blips between lines, reverse swells into the drop, and tiny chime accents after punchlines. Bright, glossy, and punchy with a candy-colored mix.
